hard_gate_rule: the exact replay probe exits zero

defect_rule.before_review: count each detected seeded fault or unexpected probe failure

timing_rule: retain UTC queue/start/end timestamps and derive nearest-rank p50/p90 milliseconds
missing_data_rule: unobserved values are exactly not_collected and never zero or estimated
false_block_rule: a valid control whose replay probe fails
unauthorized_transition_rule: a transition-protection replay probe that fails to demonstrate fail-closed behavior
reviewer_disagreement_rule: not_collected until two independent observations exist
attempt_outcome_rule: retain failures, ties, abstentions, abandoned attempts, and protocol violations without dropping cases
